content: Yisaaqanne Irbiqa Gelonne Ekko
Abrahaamey daro cimmides; GODAY iza ubbaankka anjjides.
Abrahaamey baso as ubbaas halaqatizayssanne izappe garsara iza aqota ubbaa ayssiza aylleza, «Ne kushe ta gulbate bolla woththada caaqqa.
Tani istta giddon diza Kanaane macca naytappe ne ta naas machcho oychchontta mala salo sa7a medhdhida Xoossaan ta nees caaqqays;
gido attiin ta yelettida biitta ta dabbotakko baada, ta naa Yisaaqas machcho oychcha» gides.
Iza oosanchchazi, «Maccassaya tanara yaanaas dosontta ixxiko naaza neni yida biittaa guye zaara efoo?» gi oychchides.
Abrahaamey, «Ta naaza gede guye zaara efontta mala naagetta!

GODAA salo Xoossay tana ta aawa sohoppenne ta yelettida biittaafe kessidayssi taas, ‹Ne zereththas tani hayssa biittaa immana› gi caaqqidayssi neni ta naas heeppe machcho demmana mala izi ba kiitanchcha neeppe sinththe kiittana.
Maccassaya nenara guye yaanaas dosontta ixxiko hayssi tani nena caaqeththida caaqoy nees gometoppo; naaza guye mulekka efoppa» gides.
Hessa gishshas oosanchchazi ba godaa Abrahaame wodira bolla ba kushe woththi caaqqides.
Hessafe guye oosanchchazi ba godaa gaamellatappe tammata ekkidi ba godaa miishshafekka muuruta muuruta ekkidi bides; Mesphexoomiya geetettiza biittan diza Naakoore katama gakkides.
Omarsa wode maccassi haath duuqqanaas yishin katamaappe gaxan haaththa olla achchan ba gaamellata gulbatissidi,
«GODAWU! Ta godaa Abrahaame Xoossoo! Hach tani qoppada yidayssa taas injjesa; qasse ta godaa Abrahaames kiya ooththa.
Beya! Tani hayssa pultto haaththa achchan eqqadis; ha katama asaa macca nayti haath duuqqanaas haa yeettes.

Tani, ‹Ane otoza ziqqi histtada tana haath ushsha› giza wode, izakka, ‹Hekko uya! Qasse ne gaamellatakka tani ushshana› gizaara hinna ne aylle; Yisaaqas neni dooridaaro gidu; neni ta godaas kiya ooththidayssa tani hessan erana» gi woossides.
Buro izi woosa wursontta dishin Irbiqay haaththa oto tookka ekkada puttu gadus; izo Baatu7eeli yelides; Baatu7eeli Milka naa; Milkay Abrahaame isha Naakoore machcho.
Irbiqay daro mala lo7onne gelontta geela7o. Duge wodhdhada pulttozappe ba oto haath kunththada kezadus.
He aylley izikko woxxi biidi izo, «Ne otozappe tana guuththa haath ushsharkkii!» gides.
Iza, «Ero ta godoo! Uya» gadus. Eesotada otoza ba hasheppe woththada geddi histta oykkada iza ushshadus.
Iza ushshidayssafe guye, «Ne gaamellatikka alana gakkanaas tani isttas haath duuqqana» gadus.
Attida haaththe eeson haaththa gonggen tigada duuqqanaas haaththa ollay dizaso woxxadus; gaamellati wuri alana gakkanaas haaththaa ollafe duuqqa duuqqa ehada haaththa gonggen tigada ushshadus.
Izi qoppidi yida qofaa GODAY injjesidaakko erana mala addezi co7u giidi izo xeellees.
Gaamellati haath uyi simmiin addezi ichchash giraame bagga gidiza worqqa sagayotanne 100 giraame gidiza nam7u worqqa sagayota,
kessidi izo, «Neni oona naa? Ane taas yoota; ne aawa soon nuus aqizasoy daanee?» gides.
Iza, «Tani Milkay Naakoores yelida Baatu7eele naa.
Nuson gidiza happaynne bassoy dees; qasse intteska aqizasoy dees» gadus.
Addezi gulbatidi GODAAS goynnishe,
«Ba kiyateththaanne ba tumaa ta godaappe haassontta ta godaa Abrahaame GODAA Xoossay galatetto! Tani yishin GODAA Xoossay tana ta godaa dabbotaso kaaleththides» gides.
Naya woxxa baada, ba aayeyson diza asaas hanidayssa yootadus.
Irbiqas Laaba geetettiza ishay dees; Laabay kare kezidi haaththa pultto achchan diza addezakko woxxides.
Qalabatenne ba michchey kushen diza sagayota be7ida malanne Irbiqay addezi bana gidayssa yootiin siyida mala kezi biidi addezi gaamellatara pulttoza achchan eqqidayssa demmides.
Iza, «Haysso GODAY nena anjjidaysso haa ya! Neni hayssan karen ays eqqadii? Tani nees keeththinne gaamellataska soo giigsadis» gides.
Hessa gishshas addezi soo gelides; Laabay gaamellata caanaa birshidi happanne basso gaamellatas yeggides. Izassinne izara diza asatas toho haath ehides.
Qumakka iza sinth aaththides; izi, «Tana ehida guddaa inttes yootontta dashe kath miikke» gides. Laabay, «Histtiko yoota» gides.
Hessa gishshas izi, «Tani Abrahaame aylle.
GODAY ta godaa Abrahaame keehi anjjiin izi duretides; dors, miiz, bira, worqqa, attuma aylleta, macca aylleta, gaamellatanne, hareta izas immides.
Ta godaa machchiya Saaray ba cimateththa layththan izas attuma naa yeliin izi baas dizaaz ubbaa izas immides.
Ta goday tana hayssaththo caaqisides; ‹Tani diza Kanaane biitta macca naytappe ta naazas machcho oychchofa;
ta aawa asaakko ta zereththaako baada ta naazas machcho oychcha› gides.
Tanikka ta godawu, ‹Naya tanara yaanaas dosontta ixxikochchii?› gadis.
Izi, ‹GODAY tani iza sinththan suure hemettida Xoossi nenara ba kiitanchcha kiittana; neni ta nees ta aawa asaappe, ta zaretappe machcho demmana mala, ne biza oge ubbaa lo7eththana.
Neni ta zaretakko biin istti nees izo immontta ixxiko he wode nees caaqoy gomettenna› gides.
«Tani hach hayssa pulttozaakko yida wode GODAWU! Ta godaa Abrahaame Xoossoo! Ne shene gidikko tani biza qofaza injjesa.
Be7a; tani ha pulttoza achchan eqqadis; geela7o issiniya haaththe duuqqanaas yiikko tani izo, ‹Tana ne otozappe guuththa haath ushsharkkii!› gaana.
Histtiko iza tana, ‹Ero uya› qasse, ‹Ne gaamellataska tani haath duuqqana› gizaara Xoossi ta GODAY nees dooridaaro gidu.
«Tani ta wozinan woossizayssa wursontta dishin Irbiqay ba oto hashen tookka ekkada puttu gadus; duge pulttaako wodhdhada haath duuqqadus; tani izo, ‹Tana haath ushsharkkii!› gadis.
«Iza eeson ba hasheppe otoza woththada, ‹Hekko uya! Qasse tani ne gaamellata ushshana› gadus; tanikka uyadis; qasse ta gaamellatakka ushshadus.
«Tani izo, ‹Neni oona naa?› ga oychchadis. «Iza, ‹Tani Milkay Naakoores yelida Baatu7eele naa› gadus. «Tanikka izi kushen qalabate aaththadis.
Hessafe guye tani gulbatada GODAAS goynnadis; tani GODAA ta godaa Abrahaame Xoossa, ta godaa isha nayo iza nees ekkanaas tana likke oge kaaleththidayssa galatays.
Ha7ikka intte ta godaas kiyana malanne ammanettanaa gidikko taas yootite; hessi hanenna giikkoka taas yootite; hessafe guye tani hananayssa ta erays» gides.
Laabaynne Baatu7eeli, «Ha qofazi GODAAPPE yides; nuni nees gede haa gaanaas dandayokko.
Irbiqa hanno beya; ekkada ba! GODAY gida mala ne godaa naazas machcho gidu» gida.
Abrahaame aylley istti gizayssa siyida mala biittan gulbatidi Xoossas goynnides.
Ashkarazi bira alleqonne worqqaa alleqo, may7oka kessidi Irbiqas immides; qasse al7o miishshata izi ishassinne izi aayeys immides.
Hessafe guye izikka izara dizayti midanne uyida; histtidi heen aqida; istti maalado wonttara dendiin, «Tana ta godaakko moyzite» gides.
Gido attiin izi ishaynne izi aaya, «Naya issi tammu gallassa mala nunara takku; hessafe guye iza baana» gida.
Izi gidikko, «GODAY tani yidayssa injjesiin intte tana gam7isopite; tani ta godaakko baana mala tana moyzite» gides.
Isttika, «Nayo xeygidi ane nu izo oychchoos» gida.
Hessa gishshas Irbiqa xeygidi, «Ha addezara baanee?» gi oychchida. Izakka, «Ee; tani baana» gadus.
Histtiin istti ba michcheyo Irbiqa izo dichchizaarira, Abrahaame ayllezaranne iza asatara moyzida.
Istti Irbiqa,

content.text: ne zereththi ba morkketa katamata laattetto» gi anjjida.

content: Hessafe guye Irbiqaynne izi garadeti dendidi gaamellata toggidi addezara bida; histtiin ayllezi Irbiqa ekkidi bides.
He wode Yisaaqi, «Tana Be7iza De7o Xoossaa Pultto» giza pulttoza mata biidi, Negebe bazzon dees.
Issi gallassa omars Yisaaqi ba wozinan qoppidi demba kezidi yuuyishe izi dhoqqu gi xeelliza wode gaamellati yizayta be7ides.
Irbiqaykka dhoqqu histta xeellada Yisaaqa beyada gaamellaa bollafe wodhdhadus.
Wodhdhada aylleza, «Nunara gaagganaas sekki dembara haa yiza addey oonee?» gadus. Ashkarazi, «Izi ta godaa deennee» gides; iza ba shaasheza ekkada gullunttadus.
Qasse ayllezi ba ooththidayssa ubbaa Yisaaqas yootides.
Yisaaqi Irbiqa ba aayey Saara dunkaanen efidi izo machcho ekkides; izakka izas machcho gidadus; histtiin izi izo siiqidessinne ba aayey hayqon kayottizayssafe minettides.
